title: Luria-Bertani (LB) Broth

references.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

purpose: A general-purpose liquid medium used to grow starter and overnight cultures, most commonly Escherichia coli, for downstream applications such as plasmid preparation, protein expression, or subculturing onto plates.

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

compositionPerLiter.amount: 5-10 g (varies by Lennox vs. Miller formulation)

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

preparationSummary: Dissolve the components in distilled/deionized water, dispense into flasks or tubes, and sterilize before inoculation; add any heat-labile antibiotic only after the broth has cooled to a safe handling temperature.

sterilization.value: commonly autoclaved at 121°C for 15-20 minutes for typical batch volumes
sterilization.dependsOn: batch volume, container, and autoclave validation — not a universal setting for every load

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

storage: Store sterile, unopened broth at room temperature away from light; once opened or inoculated, use promptly rather than storing long-term.

shelfLife.value: manufacturer-stated shelf life varies by product and storage condition

expectedAppearance: Pale amber, clear liquid when properly prepared and sterile; turbidity after inoculation indicates growth.
qualityControl: Confirm sterility of an uninoculated control tube/flask before use in critical work.
manufacturerNotes: Aeration (shaking speed, flask-to-volume ratio) strongly affects growth rate and yield in LB broth culture and should be kept consistent between experiments.
